name: Magnum Seiba
tagline: Run your Tesla from a chat window - climate, charging, locks and routes
description: Pairs with the Teslr integration so a parked car answers to a chat window. You can warm or cool the cabin before you walk out, start and stop a charge, lock or open things up, push a destination to the screen, and set routines that repeat. Answers come back clipped and faintly theatrical.
author: Kamkom05
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
